description: Erection of a part single part two storey side and part first floor rear extension to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (SB/43/2019FD  Received:  19 December 2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the single storey side and rear extensions hereby approved.

Condition : 5 - Prior to the completion of the part single storey, part two storey side and rear extension, the existing side garage shall be fully demolished to ensure that it does not connect to the part single storey, part two storey side and rear extension hereby approved, and shall be permanently retained as such.
